_about: Place lines rewritten in plain words and approved by John (U51, 2026-11-10). Every fact is from the cited source; nothing is added. writeCityToFirestore applies these over whatever the pipeline produced, so a later run cannot put the old wording back. scripts/apply_description_overrides.py writes them to the live atlas. Key: the waypoint id.

grand-island-ne-stolley-park-the-prairie.line: Prairie pioneer museum with Railroad Town, a living-history 1890s village of original buildings.

grand-island-ne-fonner-park-the-east-sid.line: Thoroughbred racetrack since 1954; the Hall County and Nebraska State Fairs are held here too.

west-wendover-nv-central-district-wendov.line: The Stateline Casino's 1952 sign, now the town's landmark.

rock-springs-wy-north-of-the-tracks-reli.line: A 1936 concrete-and-steel coal tipple where coal was sorted by size until 1955; much of the machinery remains.

brownwood-tx-downtown-brownwood-howard-p.line: A private Baptist university, founded in 1889.
